items.quote: And Moses spake unto Aaron, Say unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, Come near before the LORD: for he hath heard your murmurings.
items.claim: The text (verse 16:9) says Moses told Aaron to call the whole congregation of the children of Israel to come near before the LORD, because the LORD had heard their murmurings. This is a claim made inside the text, not a verified historical event. Matching the verse to Exodus 16:9 (KJV) comes from model-prior only and is not stated in the document.
items.action: instructed Aaron to summon the congregation before the LORD
items.object: the congregation of the children of Israel
items.mechanism: the LORD's response to the people's murmurings
